name: vn.fpt.campusstay.controller.assignment.OperationalMoveController
comment: Operational moves during a Term (spec §6.13): Staff inside their Blocks, Managers everywhere; nothing is charged.

methods.name: options
methods.comment: {@code q}: a student code, instead of the Allocation.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.OperationalMoveService
comment: Operational moves (spec §6.13, D-14, D-31): Staff (inside their Blocks) or a Manager move a student to another Bed of the same Term for a recorded reason (Room unusable, safety, serious conflict, other). Nothing is charged or refunded. A move of a resident cuts their stay in the old Room (its door code rotates) and releases the new Room's code; the next-Term Allocation follows to the new Bed unless the decider keeps it. A next-Term Allocation can be moved too; once the next-Term fees are issued only a Manager does it: an unpaid fee is voided and issued again for the new Bed, a paid one allows only a Bed of the same price.

methods.name: moveNextTerm
methods.comment: Checks a move of a next-Term Allocation. After the next-Term fees were issued only a Manager moves it: a paid fee allows only a Bed of the same price; an unpaid one is voided (and issued again by the caller).

methods.name: followNextTerm
methods.comment: The student's next-Term Allocation follows to the same Bed when it is free in the next Term.

methods.name: mayMoveInto
methods.comment: Staff decide moves inside their Blocks; a move to another Block is a Manager's (ADR-19).
